name: Chicken Caesar Lettuce Wraps with Parmesan & Toasted Bread Crumbs

instructions.primary_message: Place mayo, dressing, and spices in a large bowl. Stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup mayonnaise
⅓ cup Caesar dressing
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 sticks celery
3 green bell peppers
3 heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl.
Place chickens on the cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones. Chop chicken into small pieces and add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (850 g) whole chickens rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: Add Parmesan to the bowl and stir to combine the chicken salad; set aside.
Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add bread crumbs and toast, stirring frequently, until golden brown, 3-4 minutes. Transfer toasted bread crumbs to a small bowl, then add additional garlic powder and salt; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup panko bread crumbs
¾ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; fill with chicken salad, then top with bread crumbs and additional Parmesan. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat
